propositions: A new plan-review criterion `ac-process-gate` must fire on acceptance criteria whose completion predicate is entirely a generic, ticket-agnostic mechanical gate (children-closed, tests/CI pass, plan-review passes, etc.) that CI or rebar enforces for every ticket regardless of subject.

The criterion must pass (no finding) on acceptance criteria that name or depend on this ticket's specific deliverable (named feature, artifact, behavior, config, or criterion), even when their subject is tooling/tests/plan-review.

The criterion is registered as a non-grounded 1-TURN advisory member of CANONICAL_LLM, with routing entry in criteria_routing.json specifying facet=ac-text-quality, posture=advisory, scope=[container,leaf].

The criterion is implemented via a rubric prompt file (plan_review_ac_process_gate.md) with front-matter execution_mode=single_turn, and includes a litmus test ('would this AC read identically on an arbitrary unrelated ticket?') and an anti-FP silence rule.
Live bounded-sanity evaluation must confirm recall=1.0 and false_accept=0.0 on a committed eval corpus of at least 4 cases (≥2 process-gate fires, ≥2 deliverable passes).
The registry chunk-packer was refactored to avoid singleton trailing chunks and the stale hard-coded criteria COUNT was removed from docs/plan-review-gate.md.
